defs.doc:
Days past due, the worst of the last year and whether the account was ever
cured from sixty days late, for events sorted by (account, ts).
A queue of open bills per account, oldest first; each payment instant records
the days past due it ended, for the trailing-year maximum.
The worst value over a year needs only the peaks before payments, because
between payments days past due can only grow.
account  the entity key, sorted ascending
ts  event time, int64 nanoseconds, ascending within an account
billed  the amount of a new bill due at the event, cents
paid  the amount paid at the event, cents
@ 9a0f486c
defs.intent: Days past due, the worst of the last year and whether the account was ever cured from sixty days late, for events sorted by (account, ts).

steps.text: the instant's rows see the state before their own bills and payments
the instant's bills join the queue, credit paying them first
payments close the oldest bills first
